## Method

- Recorded: `experiments/combo_a`–`combo_e`, `q1.md`–`q5.md` (round 1, April 2026; distances printed with 3 decimals).
- Reproduced: `experiments/round1_reproduction_run/combo_a`–`combo_e/results.json`, written by `experiment_runner.py --combos a b c d e --corpus round1 --retrieval-only`: each combo rebuilds its own Chroma collection with its round-1 chunker and retrieves with its round-1 settings; no LLM call.
- A cell (combo × question) matches when the reproduced cites have the same chunk ids (source file + chunk index) in the same order as the recorded cites, and every |recorded distance − reproduced distance| ≤ 0.001. Retrieval settings in each results.json (chunking, top-k, max distance, truncation, hybrid, expansion) must equal the round-1 settings, otherwise all five cells of that combo count as mismatches.
